dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar is the deity us Frostmoon Scions have faith in. Whether she answers our prayers or not, wherever she may go — we will follow.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Because she is the merciful new moon, the successor of the Frost Moon, and a god deserving of our praise. You should try praying to her too, for her gentle light never fails to illuminate all in this sublunary sphere.
